name: com.lingkyn.scene-flow.unity
description: ScriptableObject binding of each Core SceneId to one scene registered in the pinned editor's build scene list, with fail-closed binding validation and stable codes, an injectable ISceneLoaderSurface seam over additive scene loading with a real wrapper and a test fake, a plain runtime constructed with explicit references that maps Core phases to additive asynchronous loads, activation, unloads, and a fade surface, forwards engine completion and failure as Core intents, and reports every by-name resolution failure as a diagnostic, for the Lingkyn Scene Flow Core.
